facts.business: Zuari Agro Chemicals Limited has ceased its primary business operations and is evaluating new business opportunities including strategic diversification into mining activities.

auditor.name: M/s. K. P. Rao & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter: Assessment of Going Concern Basis - The Company has ceased its primary business operations, currently has no revenue from operations, and is evaluating new business opportunities including mining activities. Management has concluded no material uncertainty exists regarding going concern.

key_risks: Going concern risk due to cessation of primary business operations and no revenue from operations
Uncertainty in pursuing new business opportunities including mining diversification
Dependence on realisable value of immovable properties and financial investments to cover liabilities
facts.related_party_note: Inter-corporate deposits from related parties of INR 35,850.00 Lakhs (unsecured) carrying interest rate of 9.25%-12.00% p.a., repayable within 12 months.
